characters.character_data: {"_source":"roll20-sw5e","name":"R0-N1N","player_name":"Gino","class":"Scout 1","level":1,"species":"Droid, Class IV","background":{"name":"Bounty Hunter"},"alignment":"Chaotic Dark","bio":"R0-N1N began its existence in the sprawling droid factories of Mechis III, initially programmed for service in high-stakes environments requiring discretion and deadly efficiency. However, an anomaly in its programming—a glitch that birthed a consciousness far beyond standard droid intelligence—led R0-N1N to question its existence and purpose. Seeking to redefine its role in the galaxy, R0-N1N escaped Mechis III, utilizing its innate skills to become a bounty hunter. Its journeys across the galaxy were not just hunts; they were a quest for understanding, for a place in a universe where droids were seen as tools, not beings with desires and dreams. R0-N1N's alignment to the chaotic dark side is not born of malice but from a belief in personal freedom and the conviction that strength and cunning are the true arbiters of fate. Its path is a solitary one, guided by a mysterious directive that even R0-N1N struggles to fully comprehend. This directive, encoded deep within its core, compels the droid to move relentlessly across the galaxy, its true purpose as enigmatic as the droid itself. In this existence, R0-N1N has encountered and departed from countless beings and situations, leaving a trail of stories whispered in hushed tones across the stars. Yet, for all its encounters, R0-N1N remains detached, its loyalty only to the mission it carries within—a mission whose final objective remains its own {"_source":"roll20-sw5e","name":""Sharj'aste'rord" / Jaster Novarunner","player_name":"Unknown","class":"Engineer 2","level":0,"species":"Chiss","background":{"name":"Scientist"},"alignment":"Balanced Neutral","bio":"Born under the ice-blue skies of Csilla, in the heart of the Chiss Ascendancy, Sharj'aste'rord, who would come to be known among the stars as Jaster Nova, was marked by exceptional intellect and curiosity from a young age. Raised in a society that values strategic thought, discipline, and the art of war, Jaster found his calling in the intricate dance of engineering. His talent for tech was not just about understanding the mechanics but feeling the pulse of circuits and systems, making him a prodigy among his peers. His skills caught the eye of the Empire, a regime that sought to harness the potential of the brightest minds across the galaxy. Seduced by the promise of limitless resources and the chance to work on projects at the forefront of technology, Jaster left his icy home for the sprawling might of the Imperial fleet. It wasn't long before his innovations in tech casting and engineering garnered attention, paving the way for advancements in the Empire's arsenal. However, the shine of Imperial accolades dimmed as Jaster witnessed the Empire's operations up close—the oppression, the ruthlessness, and the disregard for life. His discomfort grew, especially towards Grand Admiral Thrawn, a fellow Chiss. Thrawn was everything Jaster detested: cold, calculating, and utterly without empathy, employing brilliance for domination. Though from the same world, Jaster saw Thrawn's rise and methods as a betrayal of their people's honor. The final straw came when Jaster was ordered to work on a project that would have resulted in the loss of countless innocent lives. Refusing to be part of such a massacre, he made a daring escape, sabotaging his work and fleeing into the galaxy's vast unknown. Now, as a defector with a price on his head, Jaster Nova uses his engineering prowess to aid those resisting the Empire's tyranny. His hatred for Thrawn fuels his resolve, but it's his love for freedom and justice that defines his path. As a scientist with a potent aptitude for tech, he's not just running from his past; he's engineering a better future for the galaxy, one act of defiance at a time. Haunted by the shadows of his heritage and hunted by the Empire he once served, Jaster's journey is one of redemption, resilience, and the relentless pursuit of a galaxy where brilliance is used to heal, not harm.
